# OpenPlanner capabilities

<!-- Generated by `npm run capabilities:docs` in functions/ from functions/src/api/routes/chat/capabilities/, do not edit. -->

Assistant = the in-app chat, the Slack bot and `openplanner chat` (one agent). Its writes are proposals a human applies; the "not available" rows are listed in its system prompt so it says so instead of improvising.

| Area          | Capability                                                                                | REST route                                                             | CLI                              | Assistant (web chat + Slack)   |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| event         | Read event settings                                                                       | `GET /v1/:eventId/event/details`                                       | `event get`                      | `getEvent`                     |
| event         | Update event settings (name, dates, tracks, formats, categories, branding, custom fields) | `PATCH /v1/:eventId/event`                                             | `event update`                   | `proposePatchEvent`            |
| event         | Read the published public JSON                                                            | `GET /v1/:eventId/event`                                               | `event public`                   | not available                  |
| event         | Storage and network usage                                                                 | `GET /v1/:eventId/usage`                                               | `event usage`                    | not available                  |
| event         | Create or delete an event, manage its admins, API key, webhooks and integrations settings | —                                                                      | —                                | not available                  |
| publish       | Update website: regenerate the public/private JSON and call the webhooks                  | `POST /v1/:eventId/deploy`                                             | `event deploy`                   | `proposeDeployEvent`           |
| publish       | Storage paths of the exported files                                                       | `GET /v1/:eventId/deploy/files`                                        | `event files`                    | not available                  |
